about_the_game:
Eclipse Breaker is a lost PSX-era action roguelike "remastered” for today. Master fast-paced combat inspired by classic Active Time Battle mechanics, steal divine powers, and fight through ever-changing dungeons in a relentless cycle of epic boss battles.

A “Remastered” Classic… That Never Existed?

Eclipse Breaker feels like the game you rented in 1997 and never finished... until now. Returning to your save file 25 years later, this “lost” classic makes its grand debut: fully “remastered” (read: built from scratch) with smooth mechanics, updated visuals, and the challenge today’s roguelike fans expect.

Modern Roguelike Meets Active Time Battle

A Fast-Paced, Strategic ATB-like System – Modernized for action, every battle balances timing and relentless divine punishment. Dodge attacks, block incoming strikes, and reposition on the battlefield while managing cooldowns, chaining abilities, and seizing the perfect moment to strike.

Ever-Changing Divine Realms – Procedurally generated dungeons shaped by the elemental gods who rule them. Defeat these celestial warriors and discover new elemental abilities, crafting new builds every run. No two runs are the same.

Choose Your Allies, Reconnect with the Past – Select from a roster of Companion Spirits, the lingering souls of Ember’s former friends and party members. They grant powerful abilities, guide her through battle, and challenge her with their own regrets, humor, and memories. Their past lives fuel your fight, and who you bring with you shapes your journey.

Face Powerful Gods and Endless Foes – Battle a pantheon of bosses and enemies, each with unique attack patterns, elemental abilities, and unpredictable tactics.

The Story: A Hero Out of Time

You played Eclipse Breaker back in 1997. You fought through its relentless dungeons, battled gods, and pushed forward run after run… until life got in the way. Now, 25 years later, you're dusting off your memory card and booting it up again. But things have changed for you and its hero.

You are Ember, the warrior who vanished. 25 years ago, she stood at the edge of history, ready to defeat the rogue sun goddess Solara. Then, in the blink of an eye, she was gone. Now, she’s back—only to find that the world has moved on, the sun is still missing, and everyone thinks she’s a legend… or blames her for everything.

To restore the world’s light, Ember must battle through the ever-shifting Divine Realm, face elemental gods, and confront Solara herself—again and again until the cycle is broken.
